description.value: Walmart Supercenter (Store 3199) is one of the largest retail destinations in Quesnel, offering a full grocery department alongside electronics, clothing, toys, furniture, and baby products under one roof. For a touring cyclist on Highway 97, it represents a reliable resupply point in a mid-sized northern BC city where options can be sparse between communities.
